transcript.en: Can I help you?
transcript.zh: 需要帮忙吗？

transcript.en: Yes, I've just moved to this area with my wife and children and I'd like to know where we can all register with a doctor at a Health Center.
transcript.zh: 是的，我刚和我的妻子、孩子搬到这里，我想知道我们在哪里可以与健康中心的医生登记。

transcript.en: Okay.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Well. There's doctor Green at the Harvey Clinic.
transcript.zh: 在哈维诊所有格林医生

transcript.en: We always will recommend her for babies, because she is very good with them and she runs a special clinic.
transcript.zh: 我们总为婴儿推荐她，因为她和他们相处的很好，而且她经营一家特殊的诊所。

transcript.en: Oh... actually my youngest child is five, so that wouldn't be any good for us.
transcript.zh: 事实上，我最小的孩子5岁了，所以这对我们没有帮助。

transcript.en: Right.
transcript.zh: 好的。

transcript.en: Is there anywhere else I could try?
transcript.zh: 还有别的地方我可以试试吗？

transcript.en: Yes, the Eshcol Health Practice is the next one on my list.
transcript.zh: 是的，我的单子上的下一个是Eshcol健康诊所。

transcript.en: How do you spell that?
transcript.zh: 怎么拼写？

transcript.en: E-S-H-C-O-L. And it's Doctor Fuller, who has space on his list.
transcript.zh: E-S-H-C-O-L。富勒医生，他还有名额。

transcript.en: The clinic only opened a year ago, so the facilities are all very modern.
transcript.zh: 诊所是一年前刚开的，所以设施很现代，

transcript.en: That sounds good.
transcript.zh: 听起来不错。

transcript.en: And it's particularly good if you are busy during the day, because they also do the appointments in the evening.
transcript.zh: 如果你白天很忙也没有关系，因为他们在晚上也可以预约。

transcript.en: They closed on Saturday, though.
transcript.zh: 但是，他们在周六关门。

transcript.en: The only other place on the list is the Health Center on Shore Lane.
transcript.zh: 单子上还剩下一个地方是在Shore Lane的健康中心

transcript.en: You can register with Doctor Gormley, that's G-O-R-M-L-E-Y.
transcript.zh: 你可以挂戈姆利医生的号，G-O-R-M-L-E-Y。

transcript.en: He is new there, but the center has very good reputation.
transcript.zh: 他是新来的，但是中心的名声很好。

transcript.en: Oh, yes, I think I know the road.
transcript.zh: 是的，我想我知道路线。

transcript.en: That would be the best one.
transcript.zh: 这应该是最好的。

transcript.en: Thanks.
transcript.zh: 谢谢。

transcript.en: Could you tell me, will all their services be free?
transcript.zh: 你能告诉我，他们的服务都是免费的吗？

transcript.en: Erm...there are usually some small charges that doctors make.
transcript.zh: 通常医生会有一些小额收费。

transcript.en: Let me see what it says about the Shore Lane Center.
transcript.zh: 让我看看Shore Lane中心是怎么说的。

transcript.en: If you need to be vaccinated before any trips abroad, you won't have to pay for this.
transcript.zh: 如果你在去国外旅行之前需要接种疫苗的话，你不需要为此付钱。

transcript.en: Ah, what else?
transcript.zh: 还有什么呢？

transcript.en: The sports injury treatment service operates on the paying basis, as does the nutritional therapy service.
transcript.zh: 运动损伤医疗服务需要付费，营养治疗服务也是一样。

transcript.en: Some health centers do offer alternative therapies like homeopathy as part of their pay-to-use service.
transcript.zh: 一些健康中心提供替代疗法，例如将顺势疗法作为付钱服务的一部分。

transcript.en: Shore Lane are hoping to do this soon.
transcript.zh: Shore Lane很快也希望这么做。

transcript.en: I think they may start with acupuncture.
transcript.zh: 我认为他们会从针灸开始。

transcript.en: And finally, if you need to prove you're healthy or haven't had any serious injuries before a new employer will accept you, you can get a free fitness check-up there, but you'd most likely have to pay for insurance medicals though.
transcript.zh: 最后，如果你需要在新雇主录用你之前，证明自己身体健康或没有严重创伤史，你可以在那里做一次免费的健康检查。不过，用于投保的体检很可能就需要自费了。

transcript.en: Okay, thanks.
transcript.zh: 好的谢谢。

transcript.en: You might be also interested to know the Center is running a pilot scheme of talks with patients.
transcript.zh: 你也许对这个感兴趣，中心正在运营一项与病人谈话的试验计划。

transcript.en: I've got the list here. Actually, they look very interesting.
transcript.zh: 我这里有一个列表，事实上，内容看起来很有趣。

transcript.en: What sort of things?
transcript.zh: 什么样的事情？

transcript.en: Well, the first one is about giving up smoking.
transcript.zh: 第一个是关于戒烟的。

transcript.en: It's next week, the 25th of February, at 7 pm, and that's in Room 4.
transcript.zh: 在下周，2月25日晚上7点，4号房间。

transcript.en: It says, the talk will stress the health benefits, particularly for people with asthma or heart disease.
transcript.zh: 会谈主要讲的是针对哮喘和心脏病人的健康福利"

transcript.en: That sounds very interesting.
transcript.zh: 听起来很有趣

transcript.en: There's also a talk for families with children. It's on Healthy Eating, and takes place at the first of March, at 5 o'clock.
transcript.zh: 还有关于有孩子的家庭的讲话。它在3月1日的5点，“健康饮食”举行。

transcript.en: Will that be at the Health Center?
transcript.zh: 这是在健康中心里吗

transcript.en: Erm, actually it's the primary school on Shore Lane.
transcript.zh: 事实上是在Shore Lane的一家小学里

transcript.en: I imagine they're inviting parents of pupils there - and it says here "all welcome".
transcript.zh: 我想他们会邀请小学生的家长，这上面写的是“全部欢迎”。

transcript.en: Mmm, I might go to that if I have time.
transcript.zh: 如果我有时间，我会去。

transcript.en: There's a couple of other talks - one giving advice about how to avoid injuries while doing exercise.
transcript.zh: 这里有许多其他的谈话，一个是关于如何避免在运动中受伤。

transcript.en: It's on the 9th of March.
transcript.zh: 这是在3月9日。

transcript.en: It's a late afternoon talk at 4.30, and it will be in Room 6.
transcript.zh: 下午晚点开讲，在4点半，6号房间。

transcript.en: It also says the talk is suitable for all ages.
transcript.zh: 上面还说这个讲话适合所有年龄层。

transcript.en: And finally, there is a talk called "Stress Management", which is...
transcript.zh: 最后一个讲话是压力管理……
